description: List a project's media assets (image/video/audio) with their URLs. Optionally filter by asset_type. Returns up to 20 with a total count. Each row carries its address as `url` (with `type` and `key`). Project assets come back as SIGNED addresses on https://thefilmradar.com/api/lab/assets/abruf/… — valid for 24 h, loadable without a session and with any User-Agent. Only older rows may still point at media.andresmarder.com, whose CDN WAF answers some non-browser User-Agents (e.g. curl's default) with 403 — prefer a browser UA there, or hand the URL to the user.

preview.description: Attach the pictures themselves, downscaled to 512px, so you can look at them without fetching anything (older media.andresmarder.com addresses answer a non-browser User-Agent with 403). The worker fetches with a browser UA. At most 4 per call; audio and video rows carry no picture and are named in preview.notes.

name: lab_list_assets
title: List Assets
